remedy: Fixed weak ridge Cox fits for BOTH death causes, applied consistently to all six analysis specifications and all replicates; theta=0.1, scale=FALSE, penalty=theta/2 times sum of squared coefficients; eps=1e-11, iter.max=60.
penalty_basis: Original treatment-coded covariates and fixed natural-spline design matrix, intercept omitted. No tuning against significance or bootstrap intervals.
composition_model: Unpenalized logistic model with original fixed age spline; convergence checked.
population: 2010–2018 base cohort. No sparse-category patients removed or reassigned.
target: Original EOD-classifiable cohort, resampled as part of the same source-patient bootstrap; common within each replicate across all definitions and 8160 restriction.
resampling: Sample original unique patient clusters with replacement from full binary source cohort; physically duplicate all records for selected patient, preserve Efron ties. Apply case definitions AFTER the same resampling.
paired_contrasts: EOD_8160 minus EOD for each decomposition component and each age-specific RD; D2/D3/D4 minus D1 for age-specific RDs and age-75 minus age-50 RD changes.
intervals: Pointwise 95 percent percentile intervals, R quantile type 7; not simultaneous, not equivalence tests.
prediction_optimization: Aggregate identical adjustment covariates with exact empirical weights; verified against original full-row prediction at tolerance 1e-10. No subsampling of target.
failure_policy: Save all diagnostic messages and errors per replicate. Do not silently replace, exclude, or treat warned replicates as clean. Audit before inference.
interpretation: Descriptive synthetic-mixture decomposition, not causal mediation; D4 is hypothetical reassignment, not validated correction. Penalized extension is distinct from original unpenalized manuscript model.
